jobs.title: Security Officer Hospital Patrol Part Time
jobs.description:
Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.



As a Security Officer Hospital Patrol Part Time in Houston, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Healthcare, and more. Join a leading team where flexibility meets opportunity. As a Part-Time Security Officer, you can build a schedule that works for you and explore new roles using our Claim a Shift platform. Learn more: aus.com/earnmore. As an unarmed Security Officer in a healthcare setting, you will monitor and patrol assigned areas, maintain a visible presence to help deter security-related incidents, and support access control operations. You will provide professional customer service and clear communication to patients, visitors, and staff while contributing to a welcoming environment. Join Allied Universal, where caring, teamwork, integrity, reliability, agility, and innovation guide our work.

Position Type: Part Time

Pay Rate: $14.00 / Hour

Job Schedule:

DayTime
Fri10:00 PM - 06:00 AM
Sat10:00 PM - 06:00 AM
Sun10:00 PM - 06:00 AM

What You'll Do:

  • Provide customer service to patients, visitors, staff, and other individuals at a behavioral health and intellectual and developmental disability care location while carrying out site-specific security-related procedures and policies.
  • Respond to incidents, behavioral health crises, and other critical situations in a calm, compassionate, problem-solving manner, following established protocols and requesting appropriate assistance when needed.
  • Conduct regular and random unarmed patrols throughout buildings, grounds, parking areas, and perimeter areas to help deter unauthorized activity and identify security-related concerns.
  • Monitor access points and visitor activity, assist with directions and facility information, and report unusual conditions or policy violations to designated personnel.
  • Complete accurate incident reports, daily activity logs, and other required documentation in accordance with Allied Universal and site procedures.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Hospital vaccinations are required.
  • At least 6 months of security-related experience is required.
  • Be at least 21 years of age.
  • Customer service experience is preferred.
  • Access control/badge experience is preferred.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us:

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial Benefits: Participate in our retirement savings plan to invest in your future.
